title: Typed intent and deterministic interconnect plans
summary: Bound agent-facing design actions to explicit schemas, dependency ordering and live backend capabilities.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-08-30. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Implemented typed design intent, strict operation schemas and deterministic compilation into dependency-ordered interconnect plans.
Bound discovery to live Configuration Engine capabilities and source evidence, explicitly separating certified, assisted-only, unsupported and externally gated behavior.

Compiled validated design intent against live product capabilities and strict operation schemas, explicitly rejecting mismatched families or incomplete source identity before authorizing native plans.
Implemented domain-specific plan lowering for interconnect instances, interfaces, routing, domains, memory configuration and planned artifacts, with explicit dependencies and semantic postconditions.

notes: A bounded engineering plan compiler is not a claim to have authored a general-purpose model/tool execution loop.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
